problem:
Given the matrix $A=[\begin{aligned}-\text{i} & \text{i} \\ 7 & 3-2\text{i}\end{aligned}]$, find the result of applying to $A$ the following elementary row operations: 

$$
{R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+\frac{7}{\text{i}}{R}_{1}
$$

feedback.problem:
Given the matrix $A=[\begin{aligned}1+\text{i} & 1-\text{i} \\ -2\text{i} & \text{i}\end{aligned}]$, find the result of applying to $A$ the following elementary row operation:

$$
{R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+\frac{2\text{i}}{1+\text{i}}{R}_{1}
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
Let's apply the row operations to $A:$

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}1+\text{i} & 1-\text{i} \\ -2\text{i} & \text{i}\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+\frac{2\text{i}}{1+\text{i}}{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1+\text{i} & 1-\text{i} \\ -2\text{i}+\frac{2\text{i}(1+\text{i})}{1+\text{i}} & \text{i}+\frac{2\text{i}(1-\text{i})}{1+\text{i}}\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}1+\text{i} & 1-\text{i} \\ -2\text{i}+2\text{i} & \text{i}+\frac{2(\text{i}+1)}{1+\text{i}}\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}1+\text{i} & 1-\text{i} \\ 0 & \text{i}+2\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the result  is 

$$
[\begin{aligned}1+\text{i} & 1-\text{i} \\ 0 & \text{i}+2\end{aligned}].
$$
